name: /ecosystem
description: Cross-project activity view from EnkratFlow hub (read-only)

steps.action: Read hub data and display ecosystem view
steps.context: Read the hub directory configured in EXOCORTEX_HUB_DIR (from ~/.exocortex/.env), falling back to checking for a hub/ sibling directory. Look for activity_stream.txt (last 50 lines) and projects/*.txt. If hub directory doesn't exist or EXOCORTEX_HUB_DIR is not set, tell the user to configure it in ~/.exocortex/.env and exit gracefully. Group events by project, show last 24h activity, show last known state per project. Suggest focus based on activity patterns (most active, stale, recent switches). Read-only — no modifications.
